title: The surprising life of honey
text: Honey {{1}} been prized for thousands of years, not only {{2}} a food but also as a medicine. Because of its low water content and natural acidity, bacteria cannot survive {{3}} it, which explains {{4}} honey found in ancient tombs was still edible. Honey is the only food produced {{5}} an insect that humans eat. However, beekeepers have recently reported worrying declines in bee populations, {{6}} could have serious consequences for agriculture, as bees pollinate many of the crops {{7}} depend on. Scientists are still not entirely sure {{8}} is causing the decline, though pesticides and disease are the main suspects.

gaps.explanation: Present perfect: honey has been prized (state continuing to now).
'not only as… but also as…' — parallel preposition phrases.
Passive agent: produced BY an insect.
Non-defining relative clause: …, which could have…
'the crops (that) we depend on' — contact clause.
'what' = the thing that — the subject of 'is causing'.
